format: NDCA professional and championship adult amateur events: round structure

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: For professional and championship adult amateur competitions a semi-final is required with eight or more pre-registered couples and a quarter-final with fifteen or more; recommended but not mandatory for multi-dance Pro/Am.

requirement: Support quarterfinal and semifinal rounds and require them per the pre-registered count for the applicable divisions; treat the Pro/Am recommendation as recommended only.
enforcement_point: Not built. NDCA advancement support is NOT IMPLEMENTED and a BLOCKER to NDCA scoring-profile activation (OD-09). Docs-only record: nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed.
interpretation_notes: Today: one callback round then a Final (audit row S-22). The rulebook's own phrase championship adult amateur must be mapped to a DanceFlow division only after the division inventory is reconciled. The Pro/Am recommendation is not mandatory and must not be enforced as such.
decision_refs: OD-09 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option C now / Option A required for a future NDCA scoring profile; retrospective audit PR #795)
